Audio Context Type

group AUDIO_CONTEXT

Define Audio Context types.

metadata_def.h

Defines

AUDIO_CONTEXT_PROHIBITED 0x0000

Prohibited.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_UNSPECIFIED 0x0001

Unspecified.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_CONVERSATIONAL 0x0002

Conversational. Conversation between humans.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_MEDIA 0x0004

Media.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_GAME 0x0008

Game. Audio associated with video gaming.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_INSTRUCTIONAL 0x0010

Instructional. Instructional audio.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_VOICE_ASSISTANTS 0x0020

Voice assistants. Man-machine communication.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_LIVE 0x0040

Live. Live audio.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_SOUND_EFFECTS 0x0080

Sound effects. Sound effects including keyboard and touch feedback; menu and user interface sounds; and other system sounds.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_NOTIFICATIONS 0x0100

Notifications. Notification and reminder sounds; attention-seeking audio.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_RINGTONE 0x0200

Ringtone. Alerts the user to an incoming call.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_ALERTS 0x0400

Alerts. Alarms and timers; immediate alerts.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_EMERGENCY_ALERT 0x0800

Emergency alarm. Emergency alarm sounds.

AUDIO_CONTEXT_MASK 0x0FFF
